attrs.label: Claim Code (optional)
attrs.description:
The 8-character code PingKit shows on your iPhone under Agents, Add an Agent.</br>
It works once and expires 10 minutes after your iPhone shows it.</br>
You can leave this empty and type the code on the agent's web page instead.

attrs.description: The group id that PingKit Agent files will be owned by.

attrs.label: Port Bind Mode
attrs.description:
The port bind mode.</br>
- Publish: The port will be published on the host for external access.</br>
- Expose: The port will be exposed for inter-container communication.</br>
- None: The port will not be exposed or published.</br>
Note: If the Dockerfile defines an EXPOSE directive,
the port will still be exposed for inter-container communication regardless of this setting.

attrs.label: Host Network
attrs.description:
Bind to the host network.</br>
Required to see the devices on your network (new devices joining, devices going offline).</br>
Without it the agent can still watch the internet connection.</br>
With it, setting the host sysctl net.ipv4.ping_group_range to "568 568"
(the app's group ID) is suggested, so the agent can use ping.
